t: A hackable smartwatch with a bright touchscreen, microphones, and Wi-Fi.
steps: Buy the watch from the Waveshare store. Pick the version with a battery for wrist use.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Add the ESP32 board package from the Arduino boards manager.
Download the example code from the Waveshare GitHub repo for this watch.
Plug the watch into your computer with a USB-C cable.
Open the display example, pick the ESP32-S3 board, and upload it.
Try the clock and motion sensor examples next.
Move to the LVGL examples to build your own watch face.
